$comment: Visual and musical identities for agents. Identity comes from explicit configuration (byAgentType, byAgentId) or from reliable event metadata (actor.type / actor.agentType), never from free text. Initial artistic presets, not rigid rules. Colours agreed 2026-11-08: Forge royal purple, Smith copper-gold with temperature/verification states, Scout turquoise; the core is the luminous objective.

core.label: Objective
core.description: The central objective: a luminous core that gains internal structure as work is verified.

forge.label: Forge
forge.description: Planning, reasoning, review and architecture: royal-purple unfolding multidimensional geometry; harmonic foundation.

smith.label: Smith
smith.description: Coding and implementation: copper-gold crystalline structures with temperature (recent work glows) and verification (tested material cools and sharpens); tuned metallic rhythm.

scout.label: Scout
scout.description: Research and discovery: turquoise branching structures, expanding networks; flowing exploratory melody.
